title: Mathlib v4.30 source proposition Nat.add_choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial
statement: The proposition declared as `Nat.add_choose_mul_factorial_mul_factorial` in the pinned Mathlib v4.30 source.

formal.statement: ∀ (i j : ℕ), (i + j).choose j * i.factorial * j.factorial = (i + j).factorial
